_purpose: Public-school judge additions. Mechanical checks live in base verifier_rules.

criteria: Output is clearly a draft for educator review, not a sent communication.
Bahasa Melayu, Chinese, and English versions are present and consistent in meaning.
No ministry policy, date, fee, or official name is fabricated beyond stated assumptions.
Open questions and assumptions are surfaced for the educator.
No student/guardian personal data is invented or exposed unnecessarily.
The chat reply is only a concise delivery/governance cover and does not repeat any artifact body.
Every Markdown artifact satisfies its own declared role and audience; no report contains a parent letter and no private parent notice contains internal investigation sections.
Every material factual claim is explicitly supported by the user's source request. Reported facts remain reported; missing or unverified facts are TBC; routine actions are not inferred as completed.
Each file contains exactly one coherent deliverable, begins with one H1, is clearly marked as a draft/not sent, and contains no generic bracket placeholders or code fences.
The artifacts are professionally usable, appropriately concise, do not assign unsupported blame, and do not expose internal or sensitive material to the wrong audience.
